mechanic: thrust-and-fuel soft-landing — pilot a craft against constant gravity using a finite fuel reserve and vector thrust (main burn plus left/right rotation) to settle gently onto scoring pads notched into jagged terrain; touch down under a safe velocity and near-level to score, with narrow high-multiplier pads paying most, and crash on hard impact, terrain contact, or an empty tank; each stage adds steeper ground, wind gusts and refuel drops, with a scarce hover-assist pickup and banked lives
theme: synthwave moonfall — a wireframe craft drifts on a cyan thrust-flame toward glowing magenta landing pads over a jagged neon ridgeline, the fuel gauge pulsing under starfield bloom
seo_target: thrust fuel soft landing game unblocked
